Ongoing Protection

Preventative Maintenance

We offer routine preventative maintenance plans that are customizable to fit your needs and keep your home or business protected and pest free.

Spider Control

Although most spiders are harmless to humans and are even beneficial predators that keep down the numbers of other insects, they are often the most feared and disliked pest — and most people do not want them in their homes.

Ant Control

Ants are among the most prevalent and resilient pests in the country. They can be difficult to get under control and infestations can spread quickly without the help of a professional.

Rodent Control

Controlling and preventing rats and mice is very important — not only do they carry and have the potential to spread dozens of diseases, if they get into your home, crawlspace, or attic, they can cause extensive damage through their nesting and chewing behavior.

Wasp & Yellow Jacket Control

Wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets can be very problematic when they build their nests near your home. They can be territorial, aggressive, and induce a painful sting when they feel threatened — which is especially dangerous for anyone who may be allergic.

Flea Control

Fleas are blood feeding pests that commonly live on animals. There are a number of ways they could get into our homes but most often they are brought in on our pets. They have the potential to transmit disease and should be addressed right away if you notice an infestation.

Something else bugging you?

Not seeing what you’re looking for? Not sure which specific pest is bothering you? You can always contact us with questions, send a photo, or schedule an inspection so we can identify the pest and recommend the appropriate action or treatment.

Please note: we are currently not treating for bed bugs, birds, bats, moles, or wildlife.
